summary: The committed implementation matches the saved plan. src/awf/control/worker.py adds the new event/reason constants (workspace.terminal_runtime_released / TERMINAL_RUNTIME_RELEASED and workspace.terminal_runtime_release_failed / TERMINAL_RUNTIME_RELEASE_FAILED), a frozen _TerminalRuntimeCandidate dataclass, WorkerConfig.terminal_runtime_release_scan_interval_seconds (default 300s), a monotonic _next_terminal_runtime_release_scan_at deadline, _maybe_release_terminal_runtime invoked from run_once() right after _maybe_expire_due_secret_leases (line 275), and _release_terminal_runtime_resources / _list_terminal_runtime_candidates / _release_terminal_runtime_for_candidate / _record_terminal_runtime_released / _record_terminal_runtime_release_failed / _has_terminal_runtime_release_event helpers. The listing query filters status in {failed,cancelled,completed}, compose_project_name IS NOT NULL, node_id, and NOT EXISTS workspace.terminal_runtime_released; Docker/Compose IO runs outside any DB transaction; cleaner is invoked with remove_volumes=False and remove_worktree=False; the post-IO write transaction re-checks status and event presence; failure_reason/failure_message are never touched; transient closed-connection errors are swallowed and the next-scan deadline is advanced. src/awf/service/orphan_resources.py _classify (line 830) adds the kind-aware branch: terminal workspace container/network resources always classify as terminal with WORKSPACE_TERMINAL_LIVE_RUNTIME, while volume/worktree retain WORKSPACE_TERMINAL_WITHIN_RETENTION when retained and WORKSPACE_TERMINAL once past retention. All planned tests are present: tests/unit/service/test_orphan_resources.py adds test_terminal_workspace_live_container_is_leak_within_retention, test_terminal_workspace_live_network_is_leak_within_retention, test_terminal_workspace_volume_and_worktree_within_retention_remain_expected, test_terminal_workspace_mixed_runtime_and_salvage_partitions_correctly, test_past_retention_terminal_keeps_existing_behaviour; tests/unit/api/test_health.py adds test_readyz_terminal_workspace_with_live_container_reports_leak and test_readyz_terminal_workspace_with_only_retained_worktree_stays_healthy; tests/unit/control/test_worker.py adds the TestTerminalRuntimeRelease class covering release-on-failed, parametrized release on all non-destroyed terminal states, idempotent repeat calls, failure-event-preserves-original-failure-reason, skip-when-no-compose-project, skip-destroyed, skip-when-cleaner-not-configured, transient-closed-connection deadline advance, no-DB-lock-held-during-cleanup-IO, cancellation-leaves-no-success-event, and skip-active-workspaces; tests/unit/service/test_controls.py adds test_destroy_workspace_remains_authoritative_after_terminal_release_event. Some plan test names were renamed in implementation (test_release_is_idempotent_with_concurrent_calls -> test_release_is_idempotent_with_repeat_calls is sequential-only as the plan permitted; test_release_swallows_transient_db_connection_error_and_reschedules -> test_release_scan_skips_transient_closed_connection; test_release_cancellation_during_cleanup_leaves_no_success_event_and_no_stuck_claims -> test_release_cancellation_during_cleanup_leaves_no_success_event; test_destroy_workspace_remains_authoritative_for_full_cleanup -> test_destroy_workspace_remains_authoritative_after_terminal_release_event) but the scenarios match. The optional second destroy-path test was, per the plan, folded into the existing test_destroy_workspace_records_cleanup_failures. Non-goals (no new module, no schema migration, no state-machine change, no claim columns touched, no failure_reason mutation, no payload-shape changes, no PR #226 imports) are honored. Total branch diff is 8 files, +1628/-6 (including this plan and validation docs) — materially smaller than PR #226's 71 files / ~21.6k lines. AWF-owned validation evidence is now recorded at docs/awf-plans/ws_abbfd6794c16487c9c8a9ba7.validation.txt (commit 8aec12df) showing the operator-supplied focused pytest command passed with 282 tests in 173.11s against HEAD 2849ab02.
